answer: Each claim burns a fee, so the supply shrinks with every new identity and entry costs real value. A farm needs 345 separate burns, since one fee cannot cover 345 claims. The orchard test is the price tag: 345 fakes mean 345 payments. Burns are recorded on-chain, and the total burned is public. The basalt signal is visible to every grader, and the comet ledger is what makes the farm's arithmetic fail.
